title: newLoopState
responsibility: Builds inherited loop state while adding a versioned completion contract only when a task kind is explicitly requested.

inputs.name: newLoopState.root
inputs.description: Project filesystem root used to read committed source, loop metadata or verification evidence.

inputs.name: newLoopState.input
inputs.type: { name: string; goal: string; createdAt: string; from?: string; kind?: 'coding' | 'planning'; plan?: string; }
inputs.description: Loop name, goal, creation time, optional inherited template, task kind and committed plan address.

outputs.name: newLoopState
outputs.description: Initial pending steps and template lineage; a coding or planning completion contract appears only for an explicitly supplied task kind.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Invalid task kind or unavailable template is reported through the existing expected CLI error contract.
